passage:
The science teacher gave each group three bean seeds. One seed was placed in sunlight, one in darkness, and one in a refrigerator. Students had to watch them for two weeks.
Most students guessed that the seed in sunlight would grow best. They were right. The seed in darkness grew too, but it was pale and weak. The seed in the refrigerator did not grow at all.
The teacher asked, "Does this mean the cold seed is dead"
Students were not sure. She moved it to a warm place, and days later, it began to grow.
The class learned that growth can be delayed. A quiet seed is not always a dead seed. Sometimes it is only waiting for better conditions.
